programme.title: Dark Nemesis
programme.desc: A group of desperate soldiers hatch a plan to steal a Warlord's treasure and start a new life. Faced with the threat of a horrific death at the hands of the Warlord's executioners, the men escape into a desolate and forbidden land known only as the Shadowlands. Starring Kyle Walsh, Aaron Farb, Debra Lopez

programme.title: Dot Com Mom
programme.desc: In this fish out of water tale, a traditional Indian house wife, visits her successful son in the USA but this simple mother cannot cope with the modern ways and soon finds herself in trouble.

programme.title: Combat Girls
programme.desc: Marisa, a 20-year-old German girl, hates foreigners, Jews, cops, and everyone she finds guilty for the decline of her country. She provokes, drinks, fights and her next tattoo will be a portrait of Adolf Hitler.

programme.title: Dark Planet
programme.desc: Two sides, one known as the Alphas and the other the Rebels, struggle in a brutal war on Earth and in outer space. Starring Paul Mercurio and Michael York.

programme.title: Der Bunker
programme.desc: A young student seeks quiet and solitude to focus on an important work but ends up as the teacher of a peculiar boy who is home-schooled by his parents in an isolated bunker mansion.

programme.title: Divorce Invitation
programme.desc: Mike Christian, a happily married man runs into his high school sweetheart Alex, and after all these years, sparks still fly. When Mike is determined Alex is his true soul mate, he realizes he has a huge problem-he signed an iron-clad pre-nuptial agreement and his wife will not let him out of the marriage. Starring Jamie-Lynn Sigler, Jonathan Bennett, Elliott Gould

programme.title: Nosotros
programme.desc: A generational portrait of Spain's youth in a time of crisis, "Nosotros" follows a group of five friends during the weekend of the Spanish presidential election held in December 2015.

programme.title: Netherbeast Incorporated
programme.desc: It's just another day at NetherBeast Incorporated: cubicles, coffee and blood in the drinking fountain. They are, after all, vampires. But all is not well when an employee is found dead with a stake through his heart. This is going to be one "hell" of a day at the office. Starring Darrell Hammond, Judd Nelson, Robert Wagner

programme.title: My Bloody Wedding
programme.desc: A demon possessed bride and her attendants are on a killing spree and it's up to the groom and his groomsmen to stop them on the day of the bloodiest wedding ever.

programme.title: Memory of the Dead
programme.desc: A creepy, Gothic thriller involving a woman who devilishly invites friends of her recently dead husband to her mansion.

programme.title: Nerve
programme.desc: Nerve is a psychological drama that tells the story of Jakob Evans who has suffered an emotional breakdown from the death of his wife in a car accident.

programme.title: Next of Kin
programme.desc: In a rest home for elderly people, a daughter reads her mother's diary. Soon events that are mentioned in the mother's diary begin to happen to the daughter.

programme.desc: Descubre ideas creativas y sencillas de bricolaje para hacer tus propios juguetes antiestrés y divertidas manualidades de cartón. ¡Estos proyectos son perfectos para mantener a los niños entretenidos mientras potencian su creatividad y habilidades motoras finas! Prepárate para un mundo de diversión con materiales simples y muchas risas.

programme.title: Trucos para la Vida Diaria: Soluciones Sencillas para Personas Ocupadas
programme.desc: Desde correas con cremallera hasta ingeniosos consejos de organización, ¡este video está repleto de trucos que cambian la vida! Ya sea reparando cosas o organizando tu espacio, estas ideas son imprescindibles.

programme.title: Creaciones Artesanales: Proyectos de Bricolaje para tu Hogar
programme.desc: ¡Transforma objetos cotidianos en piezas de decoración elegantes con estas manualidades creativas y femeninas! Desde ruedas de bicicleta hasta vitrales, estos proyectos de bricolaje aportarán un toque personal a tu espacio.

programme.title: ¡Consejos Femeninos para una Vida con Clase y Belleza Chic!
programme.desc: Domina el arte de la elegancia con el asesoramiento de expertos en etiqueta de citas, consejos de maquillaje y trucos fotográficos altamente calificados. ¡Aprende a ser una profesional en el arte de aplicar el pintalabios, evitar errores de etiqueta y lucir fabulosa!

programme.title: ¡Increíbles tesoros escondidos y secretos revelados!

programme.title: Trucos para la Vida Cotidiana: Consejos Simples para Simplificar Tu Vida
programme.desc: Descubre ingeniosos trucos de vida que hacen que las tareas cotidianas sean más fáciles y eficientes. Desde consejos de organización hasta trucos que ahorran tiempo, esta guía ofrece soluciones prácticas para simplificar tu rutina y ayudarte a vivir de manera más inteligente, no más difícil. ¡Perfecto para cualquiera que busque optimizar su vida diaria!

programme.title: Trucos de Taller de Genios y Consejos de Bricolaje
programme.desc: ¡Descubre los mejores consejos, trucos y técnicas para soldadura, reparaciones y proyectos de bricolaje! Desde la perforación de precisión hasta el trabajo con metales y la seguridad con herramientas, estas técnicas de expertos elevarán tus habilidades en el taller al siguiente nivel.

programme.title: Creando belleza a partir de materiales inesperados: ¡Hazlo tú mismo como un profesional!
programme.desc: Desde convertir un huevo de avestruz en una obra maestra inspirada en Fabergé hasta crear una decoración impresionante con materiales cotidianos, estos proyectos DIY son pura creatividad en acción. ¡Observa cómo objetos comunes se transforman en extraordinarias obras de arte!

programme.title: Trucos Geniales de Reparación y Soluciones Ingeniosas para Tu Hogar
programme.desc: Desde consejos inteligentes de construcción hasta arreglos de bricolaje utilizando materiales simples, estos trucos harán que las reparaciones del hogar sean más fáciles que nunca. ¡Agarra tus herramientas y prepárate para enfrentar los desafíos cotidianos como un profesional!

programme.title: Ingeniosos trucos de reciclaje: convertir la basura en tesoro
programme.desc: Desde muebles hechos de materiales reciclados hasta una silla de juego construida a partir de un automóvil real, estas creaciones ecológicas demuestran que la sostenibilidad puede ser elegante. Observa cómo los desechos cotidianos se transforman en algo realmente asombroso.

programme.title: ¡Secretos de la comida y creaciones deliciosas que debes ver!
programme.desc: Desde probar comida real versus artificial hasta pelar frutas exóticas y hacer deliciosos chocolates, estos experimentos culinarios te sorprenderán y deleitarán. ¡Prepárate para algunos descubrimientos que te harán agua la boca!

programme.title: Brillantes Hacks de Reparación de Bricolaje e Ideas Inteligentes de Herramientas

programme.title: Cortar a tajos ¡te va a encantar!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

Nach dem ebenso unvermeidlichen Sieg der drei Lancer begegnen sie einem alten Bekannten aus ZeXal-Tagen: Kite Tenjo. Doch der scheint nicht besonders freundlich gesinnt zu sein …

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Yuya, Gong und Sylvio treffen in der XYZ-Dimension auf Kite Tenjo. Der hat sich seit ZeXal-Tagen jedoch sehr verändert und ist voller Zorn. Es kommt zum Duell zwischen ihm und Sylvio und Gong, das Kite mühelos gewinnt. Als er dann auch noch Yuya droht, ihn in eine Karte zu verwandeln, kommt es zum Showdown.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Nachdem Kite Sylvio und Gong mühelos besiegt hat, stellt Yuya sich ihm entgegen. Er will Kite von seiner unbändigen Wut abbringen und ihm klar machen, dass sie beiden eigentlich auf derselben Seite stehen. Doch Kite ist nur von seiner Wut und seinem Rachedurst beherrscht und lässt nicht mit sich reden …

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Nachdem Kite spurlos verschwunden ist, werden Yuya, Sylvio und Gong mit den Resten der Widerstandsbewegung der XYZ-Dimension bekannt gemacht. Das Bild ist traurig: Es sind kaum noch Kämpfer übrig, und von echtem „Widerstand“ kann keine Rede sein. Zuzu findet sich unterdessen ausgerechnet in der Höhle des Löwen, in der Fusions-Dimension, wieder …

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

Er erweist sich als formidabler Gegner, und das Duell endet unentschieden. Yuya kann noch aufschnappen, dass sein Gegner ein hoher Offizier der Duell-Akademie war: Aster Phoenix …

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Kite und Shay begegnen sich zufällig und Shay will versuchen, Kite von seiner einzelgängerischen Jagd auf Duell-Akademie-Kämpfer abzubringen und nach Hause zu holen. Das kann nur eins heißen: Duell! Doch Shay zieht den Kürzeren und um ein Haar verwandelt Kite ihn in eine Karte. Doch dann lässt er Gnade walten und zieht weiter seiner eigenen Wege …

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

Und obwohl es erst nach einer vernichtenden Niederlage aussieht, kann Yuya mit seinen Show-Duell-Künsten das Duell herumreißen und einen spektakulären Sieg einfahren. Wodurch er allerdings die Aufmerksamkeit von Aster Phoenix auf sich zieht …

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: Nachdem Yuya und Shay die Tyler-Schwestern besiegt haben, müssen sie nun gegen ein plötzlich auftauchendes Dreier-Team der Eingreiftruppe Obelisk antreten. Das Duell läuft gut, doch plötzlich wird Shay verletzt. Kite taucht überraschend auf, springt für ihn ein und gewinnt mühelos das Duell. Doch dann erscheint Aster Phoenix auf der Bildfläche und fordert sein Schicksalsduell mit Yuya ein.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

Doch daraus wird nichts, Yuya besiegt ihn mit seiner Duell-Show und kann dem grimmigen Iggy am Schluss sogar ein Lächeln entlocken.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: End Grain Sanding Test - How High Should You Go?
programme.desc: Are there diminishing returns when sanding end grain?

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Refinish & Repurpose Cabinet Doors aka From Southwest to Contemporary
programme.desc: My mom's house is full of cabinet doors that were made in a Southwestern style and its time for a change. REPlacing the cabinets is certainly an option and just rEPlacing the doors alone would work too. But what if we could use our woodworking skills to modify the doors instead.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Wall-Hanging Tool Chest Part 3
programme.desc: This one is all about assembly! I receive a lot of requests to include more details on my assembly process. This is a detail that many articles, videos, and DVDs tend to leave out, so hopefully this helps to fill some gaps. Keep in mind that every project will require a different glueup and clamping strategy, and this is just one way to get the job done.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Durable Outdoor Finish
programme.desc: Looking for a durable outdoor finish? You've come to the right place! Looking for an inexpensive solution that will never require any maintenance? This is not the finish for you.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Lessons Learned from Past Projects
programme.desc: Ever wish you could fast forward 5 years and see how your projects are holding up? That would certainly be useful information as it would let you know what worked, and what didn’t. So in this episode, I pull out a number of old projects and examine them closely for damage, flaws and evidence of wood movement.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Road Trip to Wood Werks Supply
programme.desc: While we were in Ohio, I couldn’t resist the opportunity to visit a woodworking store that I had heard great things about: The Wood Werks Store in Columbus, OH. Pictures just can’t do this place justice! Wall to wall tools, lumber from floor to ceiling, and a Rockler store built-in! Amazing!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Marking on Dark Wood
programme.desc: Marking lines on dark wood can be difficult to see. Here are some options to consider.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cleaning Dados with a Router Plane
programme.desc: One of my all-time favorite hand tools is the router plane. However, I very rarely use it to create joinery. In my shop, its sole purpose is fine-tuning. The blade can be set at a fixed distance from the base so it is incredibly effective at creating dados and grooves of a consistent depth.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Lumber Rack aka Racking My Brain
programme.desc: The lumber rack is the unsung hero of the woodworking shop. Its responsible for holding our raw materials safely, securely, and in an organized fashion until we're ready to use them.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Assembly of a PM2000 Table Saw
programme.desc: I have been running a PM2000 in my shop for nearly 10 years and the move to Colorado afforded me the opportunity to sell the old one and replace it with a newer version that features a 50″ fence and the heavier duty workbench extension. And I thought it would be a good time to show you how to assemble a Powermatic PM2000.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Sharpen a Card Scraper
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to sharpen your card scraper.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Domino Step Stool aka One Small Step
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to easily make an elegant domino step stool.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 6
programme.desc: Now we’re really getting into the meat of the project. I show how to create a jig for the hinge mortises. I also cover the joinery being used to connect the legs to the case. I finish up by cutting the dados and rabbets in the case sides, and show you just how imperfect our machines can be. The router plane saves the day!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Create Pillowed Legs
programme.desc: Whenever I make legs for a table or chair, I find it difficult to leave them square and flat on each face. Ever since I saw David Marks pillow the outside faces of his Bubinga Coffee Table on WoodWorks, I always like to consider the possibility of using that technique to spice things up.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Fancy Workbench Cabinet With String Inlay
programme.desc: A workbench cabinet that will last for generations!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 3
programme.desc: This episode is primarily focused on the design of the legs. I present several options and show how I create a basic template. At the end, you will see the final test leg. The process of cutting the leg itself will be covered in detail when we cut the final legs out of the bubinga stock.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Simple Frame and Panel
programme.desc: I'm currently working on an Executive Desk that features large panels on the sides and front. I pondered the various ways to construct the panels along with the rails and legs that would comprise the "frame" and ultimately decided on a very simple solution: face-gluing the rails to the panels.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 11
programme.desc: I resaw the spalted maple panels on the bandsaw using Laguna’s Resaw King. What a bandsaw blade! I then glue up the doors and begin creating the ebony plugs for the case. I finish up by showing my process for fitting inset doors.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Woodworking in America 2016 Interviews
programme.desc: I had a great time at Woodworking in America 2016 and I had the opportunity to interview a few notable woodworkers from around the web. You just might recognize some of these faces.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Mortise and Tenon Options aka Tenons Anyone?
programme.desc: Learn with Marc about the most important and the strongest joints in woodworking - Mortise and Tenon joints.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Beginner’s Cutting Board From the Woodworker’s Point of View!
programme.desc: A beginner's cutting board course from the woodworker's point of view.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Aging Wood with Baking Soda
programme.desc: While you are probably familiar with the pigment and dye-based stains available on the market, you might not be aware of a whole other class of stains known as chemical stains. Woods like mahogany and cherry are great candidates for chemical staining with baking soda but a wood like maple doesn't have much change, as you'll see in the video.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: You Don't Need Breadboard Ends - Ask TWW
programme.desc: You don't need breadboard ends - and that's why.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Hidden Wireless Charging in a Desk Top
programme.desc: Wireless charging is cool. Wireless charging that is completely hidden is even cooler! When I built my Executive Desk, I knew I wanted to include wireless charging as a feature but I didn't want to look at a charging pad all the time.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 4-In-A-Row Game
programme.desc: This 4-In-A-Row Game is fun for the whole family and can be made with basic materials and tools. If you're not familiar with this classic game, the goal is to achieve four discs in a row while blocking your competitor from doing the same. The fact that it's oversized makes it that much more fun.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Safety - Tablesaw Experience
programme.desc: Whenever I have a new student in the shop, I try to convey what if feels like when something is going wrong on the tablesaw. This may seem like an abstract idea, but knowing how to identify a problem before it goes too far could give you that extra second or two you need to prevent disaster.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Best Way to Set Up a Bandsaw!
programme.desc: I can say without a doubt that this is the best way to set up a bandsaw.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shellac Under Polyurethane
programme.desc: I decided to do a little experiment for myself. I wanted to see if I could find any evidence of a weakened bond between polyurethane and waxed shellac, when the shellac is used in a typical manner as a sealer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Duane’s Steamer Trunk Part 3
programme.desc: I go over some pre-finishing tips and finish the inside of the trunk. I then go through the entire assembly and glueup process from start to finish. I then discuss the trunk’s lid, which is different from the original plan.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Multi-Function Toy Chest
programme.desc: The Multi-Function Toy Chest is the 2014 Woodworkers Fighting Cancer charity build.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Tour and Sub-Panel
programme.desc: Before we get too far with the renovation details, I'd like to take a minute or two to show you the garage space itself. I'm working with about 950 square feet which is pretty respectable!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: French Cleat Storage System
programme.desc: A French cleat is as ingenious as it is simple. It involves securing a strip of wood with a 45 degree bevel to the wall, and then securing an opposing beveled strip on the back of a cabinet or anything you want to hang. Its incredibly strong and versatile. Its a great way to hang cabinetry and as you’ll see in this video, it can be used to make an awesome modular wall storage unit.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rustic Outdoor Table - Joinery and Assembly
programme.desc: A beautiful rustic table made from Western Red Cedar featuring Domino XL joinery.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rustic Outdoor Table - Tops - Ends - Finish
programme.desc: The table top and bench tops come together along with the breadboard ends. Watco Teak Oil is used for the finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Setup & Tune a Tablesaw Part 1
programme.desc: Our tools are no good to us if they aren’t tuned up properly. As the “heart” of the workshop, its crucial that our table saws are configured to perform their best. So whether you are setting up a new saw, or tuning up your current one, this video guide will get you where you need to be.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: I Bought a Sawstop! - First Impressions
programme.desc: I bought a SawStop. Hopefully I won't regret it.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Basic Tool Set for the Beginning Woodworker
programme.desc: There are lots of different opinions out there as to what you actually need to do woodworking. Truth is, you don't need much. Think about our ancestors and what they were able to accomplish using only the most rudimentary tools. But in the 21st century, we aren't building for our survival and most of us have family and day jobs that come before woodworking, so we use modern tools to help us build.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Why Did My Cutting Board Split?
programme.desc: I don't know if this ever happens to you, but sometimes my tools just get out of whack and start to sound funny. Take a listen and let me know if you have any advice. Also have you ever wondered why end grain cutting boards are prone to splitting? Here's a couple of reasons why!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: DeWalt Tracksaw Review
programme.desc: Here is my review of the DeWalt Tracksaw. As much as I tried to focus solely on the Track saw, it's nearly impossible not to draw comparisons to the Festool TS line of plunge saws. Let me sum it all up by saying you need to be really picky to find distinctions that will make a real difference to the average woodworker.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Make a Vacuum Bag aka A Pressing Matter
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to make your own vacuum bag for veneer press.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Flexible Sanding Strip
programme.desc: The first time I saw a flexible sanding strip in action was while watching an episode of Woodworks going on almost 10 years ago. David Marks incorporates lots of curves in his work and the man knows a thing or two about making them. Since then, I have made numerous sanding strips in all shapes and sizes and my curves are about as perfect and smooth as they can be.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: MicroJig MJ Splitter SteelPRO
programme.desc: In the past, we have discussed the use of Featherboards & Pushsticks as well as the benefits of using something like MicroJig's GRR-Ripper. But the one safety device we have yet to focus on, which could be considered the most important, is the tablesaw splitter/riving knife.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Wiping Varnish Shootout
programme.desc: As much as for my own curiosity as everyone else's edification, I wanted to do a side by side comparison between some popular variations of wiping varnish. I've used all of these finishes in the past but I have never used them side by side. By finishing some test boards, I figured I could not only gather information about their application characteristics but also the resulting look of the finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 7
programme.desc: I made quite a bit of progress in this video. The legs are cut from the bubinga blanks, and I finally have an opportunity to do a dry fit. I am in for a surprise as you will see, and a change is made to the original plans.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Littleton Console

So in this episode, I pull out a number of old projects and examine them closely for damage, flaws and evidence of wood movement.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Road Trip to Wood Werks Supply
programme.desc: While we were in Ohio, I couldn’t resist the opportunity to visit a woodworking store that I had heard great things about: The Wood Werks Store in Columbus, OH. Pictures just can’t do this place justice! Wall to wall tools, lumber from floor to ceiling, and a Rockler store built-in! Amazing!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Marking on Dark Wood
programme.desc: Marking lines on dark wood can be difficult to see. Here are some options to consider.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Cleaning Dados with a Router Plane
programme.desc: One of my all-time favorite hand tools is the router plane. However, I very rarely use it to create joinery. In my shop, its sole purpose is fine-tuning. The blade can be set at a fixed distance from the base so it is incredibly effective at creating dados and grooves of a consistent depth.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Lumber Rack aka Racking My Brain
programme.desc: The lumber rack is the unsung hero of the woodworking shop. Its responsible for holding our raw materials safely, securely, and in an organized fashion until we're ready to use them.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Assembly of a PM2000 Table Saw
programme.desc: I have been running a PM2000 in my shop for nearly 10 years and the move to Colorado afforded me the opportunity to sell the old one and replace it with a newer version that features a 50″ fence and the heavier duty workbench extension. And I thought it would be a good time to show you how to assemble a Powermatic PM2000.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Sharpen a Card Scraper
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to sharpen your card scraper.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Domino Step Stool aka One Small Step
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to easily make an elegant domino step stool.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 6
programme.desc: Now we’re really getting into the meat of the project. I show how to create a jig for the hinge mortises. I also cover the joinery being used to connect the legs to the case. I finish up by cutting the dados and rabbets in the case sides, and show you just how imperfect our machines can be. The router plane saves the day!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Create Pillowed Legs
programme.desc: Whenever I make legs for a table or chair, I find it difficult to leave them square and flat on each face. Ever since I saw David Marks pillow the outside faces of his Bubinga Coffee Table on WoodWorks, I always like to consider the possibility of using that technique to spice things up.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Fancy Workbench Cabinet With String Inlay
programme.desc: A workbench cabinet that will last for generations!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 3
programme.desc: This episode is primarily focused on the design of the legs. I present several options and show how I create a basic template. At the end, you will see the final test leg. The process of cutting the leg itself will be covered in detail when we cut the final legs out of the bubinga stock.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: A Simple Frame and Panel
programme.desc: I'm currently working on an Executive Desk that features large panels on the sides and front. I pondered the various ways to construct the panels along with the rails and legs that would comprise the "frame" and ultimately decided on a very simple solution: face-gluing the rails to the panels.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 11
programme.desc: I resaw the spalted maple panels on the bandsaw using Laguna’s Resaw King. What a bandsaw blade! I then glue up the doors and begin creating the ebony plugs for the case. I finish up by showing my process for fitting inset doors.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Woodworking in America 2016 Interviews
programme.desc: I had a great time at Woodworking in America 2016 and I had the opportunity to interview a few notable woodworkers from around the web. You just might recognize some of these faces.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Mortise and Tenon Options aka Tenons Anyone?
programme.desc: Learn with Marc about the most important and the strongest joints in woodworking - Mortise and Tenon joints.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Beginner’s Cutting Board From the Woodworker’s Point of View!
programme.desc: A beginner's cutting board course from the woodworker's point of view.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Aging Wood with Baking Soda
programme.desc: While you are probably familiar with the pigment and dye-based stains available on the market, you might not be aware of a whole other class of stains known as chemical stains. Woods like mahogany and cherry are great candidates for chemical staining with baking soda but a wood like maple doesn't have much change, as you'll see in the video.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: You Don't Need Breadboard Ends - Ask TWW
programme.desc: You don't need breadboard ends - and that's why.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Hidden Wireless Charging in a Desk Top
programme.desc: Wireless charging is cool. Wireless charging that is completely hidden is even cooler! When I built my Executive Desk, I knew I wanted to include wireless charging as a feature but I didn't want to look at a charging pad all the time.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: 4-In-A-Row Game
programme.desc: This 4-In-A-Row Game is fun for the whole family and can be made with basic materials and tools. If you're not familiar with this classic game, the goal is to achieve four discs in a row while blocking your competitor from doing the same. The fact that it's oversized makes it that much more fun.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Safety - Tablesaw Experience
programme.desc: Whenever I have a new student in the shop, I try to convey what if feels like when something is going wrong on the tablesaw. This may seem like an abstract idea, but knowing how to identify a problem before it goes too far could give you that extra second or two you need to prevent disaster.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Best Way to Set Up a Bandsaw!
programme.desc: I can say without a doubt that this is the best way to set up a bandsaw.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shellac Under Polyurethane
programme.desc: I decided to do a little experiment for myself. I wanted to see if I could find any evidence of a weakened bond between polyurethane and waxed shellac, when the shellac is used in a typical manner as a sealer.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Duane’s Steamer Trunk Part 3
programme.desc: I go over some pre-finishing tips and finish the inside of the trunk. I then go through the entire assembly and glueup process from start to finish. I then discuss the trunk’s lid, which is different from the original plan.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Multi-Function Toy Chest
programme.desc: The Multi-Function Toy Chest is the 2014 Woodworkers Fighting Cancer charity build.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shop Tour and Sub-Panel
programme.desc: Before we get too far with the renovation details, I'd like to take a minute or two to show you the garage space itself. I'm working with about 950 square feet which is pretty respectable!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: French Cleat Storage System
programme.desc: A French cleat is as ingenious as it is simple. It involves securing a strip of wood with a 45 degree bevel to the wall, and then securing an opposing beveled strip on the back of a cabinet or anything you want to hang. Its incredibly strong and versatile. Its a great way to hang cabinetry and as you’ll see in this video, it can be used to make an awesome modular wall storage unit.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rustic Outdoor Table - Joinery and Assembly
programme.desc: A beautiful rustic table made from Western Red Cedar featuring Domino XL joinery.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Rustic Outdoor Table - Tops - Ends - Finish
programme.desc: The table top and bench tops come together along with the breadboard ends. Watco Teak Oil is used for the finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Setup & Tune a Tablesaw Part 1
programme.desc: Our tools are no good to us if they aren’t tuned up properly. As the “heart” of the workshop, its crucial that our table saws are configured to perform their best. So whether you are setting up a new saw, or tuning up your current one, this video guide will get you where you need to be.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: I Bought a Sawstop! - First Impressions
programme.desc: I bought a SawStop. Hopefully I won't regret it.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Basic Tool Set for the Beginning Woodworker
programme.desc: There are lots of different opinions out there as to what you actually need to do woodworking. Truth is, you don't need much. Think about our ancestors and what they were able to accomplish using only the most rudimentary tools. But in the 21st century, we aren't building for our survival and most of us have family and day jobs that come before woodworking, so we use modern tools to help us build.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Why Did My Cutting Board Split?
programme.desc: I don't know if this ever happens to you, but sometimes my tools just get out of whack and start to sound funny. Take a listen and let me know if you have any advice. Also have you ever wondered why end grain cutting boards are prone to splitting? Here's a couple of reasons why!

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: DeWalt Tracksaw Review
programme.desc: Here is my review of the DeWalt Tracksaw. As much as I tried to focus solely on the Track saw, it's nearly impossible not to draw comparisons to the Festool TS line of plunge saws. Let me sum it all up by saying you need to be really picky to find distinctions that will make a real difference to the average woodworker.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Make a Vacuum Bag aka A Pressing Matter
programme.desc: Marc teaches how to make your own vacuum bag for veneer press.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Flexible Sanding Strip
programme.desc: The first time I saw a flexible sanding strip in action was while watching an episode of Woodworks going on almost 10 years ago. David Marks incorporates lots of curves in his work and the man knows a thing or two about making them. Since then, I have made numerous sanding strips in all shapes and sizes and my curves are about as perfect and smooth as they can be.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: MicroJig MJ Splitter SteelPRO
programme.desc: In the past, we have discussed the use of Featherboards & Pushsticks as well as the benefits of using something like MicroJig's GRR-Ripper. But the one safety device we have yet to focus on, which could be considered the most important, is the tablesaw splitter/riving knife.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Wiping Varnish Shootout
programme.desc: As much as for my own curiosity as everyone else's edification, I wanted to do a side by side comparison between some popular variations of wiping varnish. I've used all of these finishes in the past but I have never used them side by side. By finishing some test boards, I figured I could not only gather information about their application characteristics but also the resulting look of the finish.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Gadget Station Part 7
programme.desc: I made quite a bit of progress in this video. The legs are cut from the bubinga blanks, and I finally have an opportunity to do a dry fit. I am in for a surprise as you will see, and a change is made to the original plans.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The Littleton Console
programme.desc: A beautiful console cabinet made from Sapele, Ambrosia Maple, and Ebony.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: La doctora K encarga a Denny, un nuevo Blader, que capture los cuatro Bit Beasts sagrados con ayuda de Clarken, su poderoso Bit Beast. programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Los BladeBreakers acuden al torneo del Campeonato del Mundo para animar a Zeo, que combate en los encuentros preliminares. Este se da cuenta de que es su padre el que quiere robar los Bit Beasts de los BladeBreakers.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters
programme.desc: Zeo empieza a entrenar con su padre. Este le entrega a Cerberus, el Bit Beast más poderoso de la piedra, pero Zeo tiene que aprender a controlarlo. Poco después, Kai conoce a una extraña pareja, Rey y Reina, que lo desafían a un combate para robarle piezas de su Blade, pero éste queda tan destrozado en la batalla, que se van con las manos vacías.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Masters

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury

El grupo encuentra a un blader llamado Dynamis que afirma ser el guardián del templo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.sub-title: La leyenda del renacer de Nemesis
programme.desc: Gingka combate contra Dynamis, el guardián del templo. Gingka parece haber elegido la estrategia equivocada, pero admite que se había entusiasmado demasiado con el hecho de ser un blader legendario y confiesa que debería haber estado más atento. Dynamis queda impresionado por su sinceridad y detiene el combate para contarles a Gingka y a los demás la milenaria historia de los fragmentos estelares.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.sub-title: Los bladers de las cuatro estaciones
programme.desc: Dynamis intenta explicarle a Johannes y a sus seguidores que, hagan lo que hagan, el cielo decidirá lo que habrá de suceder con la resurrección de Hades y de Nemesis, no ellos. Tras esto se disputa un combate en el que participan todos los bladers. Kyoya está obsesionado con derrotar a Aguma y Gingka y sus amigos tienen que intervenir para detener el combate. Kyoya está furioso con Gingka y se marcha, comunicándoles que a partir de ahora seguirá su propio camino.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.sub-title: El combate en la isla Beyster
programme.desc: Gingka y sus amigos llegan a la isla Beyster, donde se han apuntado a un torneo que ha atraído a un gran número de grandes bladers. Según las normas del torneo, los competidores deben intentar llegar a la cima de la montaña enfrentándose a adversarios al azar en el camino. Los ganadores continúan y los derrotados se marchan a casa. En uno de los grandes combates, Rey derrota a Aguma, mientras que en otro, Masamune sale vencedor contra Bao.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Mientras continúa el campeonato de la isla Beyster, cada vez son más los bladers eliminados de la competición. Gingka alcanza a Kenta y se da cuenta de que será su próximo contrincante en el torneo. Mientras ellos combaten, Rey se topa con su próximo adversario, que resulta ser Ryuga. Ambos tienen beys de rotación inversa y su combate es muy intenso.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: El torneo de la isla Beyster continúa mientras un blader invisible derrota a un participante tras otro en una serie de emboscadas. Cuando vence a Zeo y a Toby, Masamune promete que se vengará en su nombre en la final. Y tiene su oportunidad cuando él y ese blader, un mercenario llamado Chris, se enfrentan en la final. Finalmente, Chris sale victorioso y sucede algo sorprendente: es él, y no Masamune, el siguiente blader legendario.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka le pide a Chris, el último blader legendario, que se una a él en su lucha contra el mal, pero Chris le responde que sólo se unirá al mejor postor. Esto y las burlas de Chris hacia Masamune enfurecen a Rey, que lo reta a un combate. Los bladers de ambos equipos se unen en un colosal combate. Ryuga aparece repentinamente y exige que Chris le entregue su bey y su poder.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Kyoya es emboscado por un grupo de bladers en las montañas, pero los derrota a todos. Le piden disculpas y le explican que creían que era un monstruo que ha estado aterrorizando a la aldea. Kyoya accede a ayudarles en la captura del monstruo, pero la primera persona a la que se encuentra es a Yu. Aunque tiene sus reservas, le acompaña en su búsqueda del monstruo.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Tithi y Yu acuerdan combatir en las ruinas y Tithi demuestra ser un duro oponente que consigue derrotar a Yu. Kyoya está seguro de que Tithi es un blader legendario, así que le reta él también a un combate. Tithi dice que él sólo combate por diversión y que tanto él como Yu creen que Kyoya se lo toma demasiado en serio. Cuando Tithi se niega a combatir, Yu le dice a Kyoya que está siendo muy cruel y Kyoya para.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.sub-title: El regreso del dios de la destrucción
programme.desc: En la guarida de Pluto en Méjico, éste utiliza el poder de los beys de algunos de los bladers legendarios para revivir a Nemesis. La energía que emiten alerta a Gingka y a sus amigos del inminente peligro y deciden ir a Méjico para detener su renacimiento antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Mientras, Ryuga también siente el poder del renacimiento de Nemesis y planea usurparlo. Kenta intenta otra vez convencer a Ryuga de que le preste su poder a Gingka y a los suyos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka y sus amigos han aterrizado en Méjico y se apresuran para detener el renacimiento de Nemesis. Dentro del templo, Rago, el hijo del sol negro, ya ha llegado. Gingka, King, Yuki, Masaune y Madoka consiguen entrar en el templo y comienza el combate. Lo que Gingka y sus amigos no saben es que toda la energía que están creando con sus combates está siendo absorbida por Nemesis, permitiéndole hacerse más y más fuerte.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: El combate para detener el renacimiento de Nemesis continúa mientras Kyoya se enfrenta a Dynamis y Tithi reta a Aguma en un templo de Méjico. Mientras, Gingka, Yuki y Madoka se marchan siguiendo una corazonada de Gingka. Ryuga también llega en busca de la fuente del poder que le ha atraído hasta allí. Gingka se enfrenta a Chris y durante el combate intenta convencerlo de que se una a ellos en el combate.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka derrota a Chris en el combate pero lo convence de que es un blader legendario y que forma parte del equipo y no está solo. Aguma es derrotado por Tithi y Dynamis convence a Aguma de que lo acompañe para seguir a Gingka y los demás. Gingka llega al templo de Nemesis, donde se encuentra con Pluto, Rago y, para su sorpresa, Doji.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: En un templo de Méjico, Rago se enfrenta a todos los que le retan, incluido Gingka y sus amigos y Ryuga. Ninguno de sus beys tiene efecto sobre el Diablo Nemesis de Rago, pues los lanza a todos por los aires. Antes de que Gingka y los demás puedan decidir qué hacer, Rago utiliza el poder de Diablo Nemesis para destruir el templo. Gingka y sus amigos son rescatados por Tsubasa, que los lleva de vuelta al cuartel general de la AMCB.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Mientras la AMCB y todos sus miembros están peinando el mundo en busca de Rago y Nemesis, Gingka y sus amigos se entrenan para el combate que les espera. Mientras, Rago, Doji y Pluto están en un barco en medio del océano, e intentan sacar a la superficie el reino hundido del rey Hades. Cuando Gingka y los demás localizan a los malvados en el océano Pacífico, corren al helicóptero de la

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka y sus amigos se dirigen hacia Nemesis en el océano Pacífico, pero el helicóptero en el que vuelan atraviesa una peligrosa tormenta. Se ven obligados a aterrizar en una isla desierta y utilizan barcas para llegar al reino perdido del rey Hades, donde creen que se encuentra Nemesis. Entre tanto, Ryuga ya ha llegado al reino perdido y ha retado a Rago y su Nemesis a un combate contra él y su bey L-Drago.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.sub-title: La estrella restante de las cuatro estaciones
programme.desc: Gingka y sus amigos intentan ayudar a Ryuga, que ha sido gravemente herido en el combate contra Rago, pero parece que es demasiado tarde para salvarlo. Sin Ryuga, Dynamis les dice que la barrera de Zeus no puede ser completada y ya no pueden obtener la ayuda de la madre naturaleza. Están solos. Los bladers legendarios y sus amigos atacan a Rago y su bey Nemesis, pero son repelidos.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Kenta y su nuevo bey, Flash Sagittario, se enfrentan a Rago y su bey, Diablo Nemesis. Gingka está convencido de que Kenta ahora tiene los poderes del blader legendario de la constelación estival, Ryuga. Los demás están de acuerdo e intentan levantar una vez más la barrera de Zeus para intentar enterrar al dios de la destrucción. Primero, el Sagittario de Kenta derrota al Darkhelm de Pluto y después todos los bladers se

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka y el resto de los bladers legendarios de las cuatro estaciones aparecen para completar la barrera de Zeus y enterrar a Nemesis para siempre, junto con Rago y Pluto, que se hunden también con la destrucción del reino perdido de Hades. La celebración dura poco, pues una pequeña fisura en la barrera de Zeus permite al dios de la destrucción reaparecer para destruir la Tierra.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fury
programme.desc: Gingka ha reunido el poder de todos los beys de sus amigos y él y Pegasus se enfrentan a Nemesis. Gingka lucha con todas sus fuerzas pero pronto se da cuenta de que el poder de Pegasus es equivalente al poder de Nemesis. Rago le provoca diciéndole que el sol negro destruirá la tierra mucho antes de que Gingka pueda derrotarlo. Las tornas cambian cuando todos los bladers del mundo envían su poder a Gingka y Pegasus y su nueva fuerza lanzan varias

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Cuando Kenta se enfrenta a los Cazadores de Caras en una batalla de cuatro contra uno y pierde, Gingka entra para darle una lección a la pandilla. Él rápidamente derrota a los matones y sus beyblades. Al día siguiente, los Cazadores de caras están de vuelta con refuerzos y su líder Kyoya. Rodean a Gingka y lo obligan a una batalla de cien a uno. Gingka se mantiene enfocado y derrota a los cien oponentes. Kyoya está impresionado y desafía a Gingka a un duelo ...

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: El nuevo amigo de Gingka, Madoka, es un experto técnico de Beyblade y trabaja en el Pegaso roto. Mientras tanto, los Cazadores de caras toman la hoja de beyblade de Kenta y se niegan a devolverla a menos que Gingka pelee con Kyoya en una batalla. Gingka acepta el desafío a pesar de las súplicas de Madoka de que Pegaso no está listo. Durante la batalla, el beyblade de Kyoya parece impenetrable, pero Pegasus puede sobrevivir y ganar.

programme.title: Beyblade Metal Fusion
programme.desc: Kenta teme que Gingka salga de la ciudad para encontrar oponentes más valiosos, por lo que desafía a Gingka a un hombre contra otro en batalla. Mientras tanto, Kyoya y sus Cazadores de caras son llevados a un área rocosa aislada por una misteriosa figura, Doji. Doji desafía a Kyoya a una batalla; acuerdan que si Kyoya pierde, tendrá que trabajar para que Doji derrote a Gingka. La pelea está en marcha y Rock Leone de Kyoya resulta no ser rival para el Lobo Oscuro de Doji.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A hit run victim collapses in a designer dress shop. Willow, a seven year old Husky, can only drag herself along the ground. Chris comes to the rescue but will Willow ever be able to walk again?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has a second call out. This time, it’s a Norwich terrier struggling to deliver her first litter of pups. It’s an emotional rollercoaster as Chris tries to save the puppies and keep the mother alive. The eight hour drama ends with a dash to the Bondi clinic for emergency surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Three month old rescue puppy Tyson is being fostered by a family for just one week. But when foster Mum, Melissa takes the puppy to Chris for a routine check up she is confronted with terrible news. Tyson needs major heart surgery or he will die. Despite the expense, the family decide to adopt Tyson because they know no one else will give him a home in his condition. Will Tyson survive the openheart surgery and have a happy future with his new family?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has rushed to the Australian Reptile Park to handle an emergency. Two Tasmanian devil babies, Lara and Lily have been struck down with a mystery illness and are close to death. Can Chris save the two critically ill sisters or is the entire devil population at the park in danger of being wiped out?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two boxer puppies are found by police wandering the streets. One has been hit by a car and is coughing up blood. Chris is called to rescue the brothers. First, he must treat the hit run victim but then it becomes his mission to track down their owners and prevent them going to an animal shelter. The trouble is Chris is bonding with the puppies and is going to find it hard to let go.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A miniature horse who is suffering from dwarfism disease was not meant to survive past six months. However his loving owner and a dedicated band of vets have beaten the odds and kept 2 year old Koda alive. Australia’s smallest horse is also a regular visitor at the Royal Children’s Hospital in Melbourne and lights up the lives of hundreds of sick kids. Now, however, the brave Koda faces another life threatening operation. Chris will be part of the elite surgical team that will decide Koda’s fate.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two heartbroken little girls and their Mum are pleading for Dr Chris to save their beloved bunny. The family came home to find something shocking had happened to little Alice. The rabbit is the girls’ first pet and only 14 weeks old. This will be one of Dr Chris’ toughest cases.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A beautiful kelpie is brought to Chris in a terrible state. A knock to the head as a puppy has caused severe balance problems but his condition is now deteriorating rapidly. His loving owner Heidi already has a baby to look after but she is constantly assisting Jasper and cannot bear the thought of losing him. In desperation, she looks to Chris for an answer. A brain scan shows his problems are inoperable but Chris refuses to give in. A custom made cart is fitted for Jasper and the sight of him moving about with his new “ wheels” is a heart warming salute to love and persistence.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Jen brings in her son’s dog Jewel to Dr Chris to find out if she’s expecting. The complication? This is an unplanned pregnancy and Jen suspects the father is her own dog, Token. X rays prove Jewel is having a football team of puppies. Get ready for a long night of anxiety, sadness and ultimately joy as Dr Chris helps Jewel through her ordeal. Funny scenes as proud father, Token keeps a close eye on proceedings to make sure his offspring are being well looked after.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A beautiful pig is about to become pork chops if she keeps digging up the family property with her broken nose ring. Her owner, Allison loves Lola and has asked Chris to find a way to stop the execution. A new nose ring is the answer. Sounds easy but sedating an angry pig turns out to be a tough challenge. Watch out for some hilarious chase scenes.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Honey has taken a death-defying leap out of a car doing 40 kms an hour to chase down a cat. Somehow the spoodle has survived but just how serious are her injuries? Owner, Ilana is suffering enormous guilt that she didn’t have the family’s pride and joy safety strapped in the car. Watch for the cat hating spoodle’s reaction when she hears her archenemies out the back of the Bondi clinic.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour. What has the huge python swallowed that is now threatening to kill him? This a case of truth being stranger then fiction.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A game of chasey at home turns ugly for Hooligan when he runs into his owner, Sarah. Hooligan’s horribly fractured leg needs major surgery at Sash but the tiny terrier has never spent a night away from his family and is not coping.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is about to be confronted with the smallest patient he has ever handled. Twelve-year old Elliot’s much-loved pet mouse, Pinot has developed a massive, cancerous tumour. But surgery on such a pint-sized patient is going to be a real challenge. Will Pinot pull through or will a young girl be shattered?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well ...try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Pearl was at her regular hairdressing appointment when she started bleeding internally. Now the pampered poodle may have minutes to live and Chris is her only hope.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Little Lucu has been attacked by a paralysis tick and the poison is rapidly shutting down her system. A round the clock watch is needed to keep this innocent victim alive. But will it be enough?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A bizarre looking baby cockatoo has fallen twenty metres out of her nest and wants to alert the whole world to her plight. Can Chris help the little screamer and will she ever be able to fly?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An emotional case for Chris as he fights to save one of the clinic’s favourite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now Bluebell is the victim of a hit run accident and all the staff at Bondi are directly affected.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew investigates a worrying lump on a horse for a possible killer disease, but can he get close enough to find out. And Doctor Rachel is feeling the pressure when a passionate wildlife warrior brings in two distressed little Aussies.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Romi faces multiple emergencies when Lucy the groodle crashes before and during surgery, and Andrew treats a seriously ill goat that could be infested with a life-threatening parasite.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew must make a life and death decision on a close friend’s pet cow. Rachel investigates why a friendly young Labrador has developed a worrying limp, but can she calm her terrified patient down enough to even treat him.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: On this episode a critically ill kangaroo infant has Andrew and the young joey’s rescuer worried for its life. Dr Romi has her hand full with eight lively puppies, but will they get a clean bill of health?

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: On this episode delicate surgery has Andrew anxious for Sally the cow’s future. And why is doctor Romi so over the moon?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: The Australian Reptile Park operations manager, Tim Faulkner ropes Chris into a frightening mission in far north Queensland. A monster seven metre python called Big Mamma is living in the roof of a local boating club and the female paddlers are terrified. It’s all up to the intrepid duo as they head to Cairns to try to capture the scary reptile.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A quick thinking police officer in Sydney’s infamous King Cross has rescued a twelve-week old puppy and rushed her into the Bondi clinic. The puppy was found sweltering in forty degree heat in a plastic handbag and the culprit has been arrested. Little Tilly soon finds a place in Chris’ heart and home where she has a confrontation with the resident cat, George. Without a microchip, the search is on for her owner.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked the five year old and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of Tigger’s injuries.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us its like “ a third testicle swinging in the wind.” But when it comes to surgery it’s no laughing matter for Chris.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Boris the Staffy was born with a cleft palate. Lucky to survive, he has now endured seven operations to try to fix the gaping hole in his mouth. All have failed and time is running out. Chronic infections are now destroying his quality of life. Like Boris, his owner Jess is refusing to give up. She’s written to Chris looking for one last chance. The surgery will be the first of its type ever performed in Australia. Eight thousand dollars needs to be raised and Chris is prepared to go all the way for Boris!

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: West Highland terrier, Chester lives in Bondi but has a fanatical hatred of skateboarders. It’s a dangerous combination and one that is making life hell for his owners Mark and Jess. They’re worried Chester could bite someone and end up in serious trouble. What can Dr Chris come up with to tame the savage terrier?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: 6 month old German Shepherd, Gypsy hasn't been able to keep any food down for weeks and is losing weight rapidly. But getting to the bottom of the problem is proving impossible as the petrified patient refuses to let anybody examine her. Lisa is seriously concerned about what has happened to this young pup. Will it be a happy ending for Gypsy?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A critically ill swan has been found caught up in a soccer net in a suburban backyard. The bird is emaciated and running out of time. Has Chris arrived in time to save the swan from certain death?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A story that is sure to touch your heart. Poppy is a Fijian native dog whose nose was cut off in a horrific hunting accident. In the north of Fiji there are no full time vets. Volunteers at Animals Fiji have managed to keep her alive with donations raised in Australia. Now Chris has gone to Fiji to bring the little girl back to Australia for major reconstructive surgery and hopefully a whole new life with an adopted family. Unless something is done, Poppy will always face serious infections and be shunned because of her shocking brutal injuries.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: One year-old Hero has been vomiting all day and his owners are worried he’s been up to his old tricks eating rocks from their backyard. Can Lisa help the naughty Labrador pass the rock or will he be forced to have major surgery?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Mitsy may appear to be normal but there is something terribly wrong. The rescue kitten is struggling to walk since being micro chipped and her foster family is worried that a misplaced chip may have caused spinal damage. Andrew Marchevsky is left with no other option but to operate. Will the surgery restore Mitzi's ability to walk or will she be made permanently worse?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is answering a call for help from May Dodd, who runs an animal shelter for abandoned donkeys. One of her residents, Dusty, has developed a very strange walk. May is worried if nothing can be done to help Dusty walk normally again, the donkey’s diminished quality of life that will be unbearable. Can Chris get to the bottom of this mysterious problem and save Dusty?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: There’s no time to rest as Chris is sent straight out to help a pregnant cow through a difficult labor. And his midwife duties are not over yet.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris’ country locum at the Kyabram Veterinary Clinic continues and some of his patients are a little out of the ordinary. Harriet the Bearded Dragon is a much loved resident of the local Fauna Park. Her Keeper Hannah is concerned about a lump that has suddenly appeared on the dragon's leg. The worry is that it could be cancer. Chris decides removing the lump is the only option, but on the operating table, things go horribly wrong. Can Chris save Harriet?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: At the Australian reptile park, Operations Manager Tim Faulkner is responding to an in-house emergency. Cameron the Cormorant has swallowed a mystery object, and it’s caused a dangerous swelling in the little bird's throat. Tim needs to remove the object urgently or Cameron may choke to death.

programme.title: Bondi Vet

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris's holiday in far north Queensland is interrupted as word of the visiting Vet has spread like wildfire. programme.title: Bondi Vet

programme.title: Bondi Vet

programme.title: Sechserpack
programme.desc: Warum darf man nicht selbst im Geschäft die gerade gekauften Schuhe zur Kasse tragen? Was für Frauen ihre Schuhe, sind für Männer ihre Autos – sagt man zumindest. Dass dann beim Autokauf auch emotionale Gründe eine Rolle spielen, versteht sich von selbst …

programme.title: Sechserpack
programme.desc: Liebe, Romantik und Erotik sind angesagt: „Gefühlsecht“ ist das heutige Thema für die „Sechserpack“-Comedians Hanno Friedrich, Thomas Held, Mirco Reseg, Shirin Soraya, Nina Vorbrodt und Emily Wood.

programme.title: Sechserpack
programme.desc: Diesmal in festen Rollen: vom schnöseligen Chefarzt, dessen karrieregeilen Assistenten und der genervten Oberärztin, bis hin zur frivolen Krankenschwester, deren frigiden Chefin oder dem cleveren Hausmeister!

programme.title: Sechserpack
programme.desc: Heute wird bei „Sechserpack“ wieder einmal geschafft, geschuftet und malocht – 30 Minuten lang ist alles „In Arbeit“! programme.title: Sechserpack
programme.desc: In dieser Episode dreht sich alles um Gerüchte, Getuschel und lästernde Mitmenschen. Alltagsnah, überdreht und typisch Sechserpack.

programme.title: Sechserpack
programme.desc: Missverständnisse, falscher Ehrgeiz und gut gemeinte Ratschläge führen in mehreren turbulenten Episoden zu chaotischen Verwicklungen. programme.title: Sechserpack

Auch die Suche nach einem Nachfolger für Strombergs alte Position gestaltet sich schwieriger als gedacht, weil es zwischen Tanja und Ulf kriselt, seit es bei den beiden nicht so recht mit dem Nachwuchs klappen will ... (P) Unterstützt durch Produktplatzierung

programme.title: Stromberg

Jennifer lässt sich deswegen von Stromberg überreden, in seinem Vorzimmer die Vertretung für Frau Papenacker zu übernehmen, immerhin kann sie so Helge mit zur Arbeit bringen. Stromberg soll das Ruder rumreißen, und verzeichnet sogar überraschende Erfolge bei diesem Versuch. programme.title: Stromberg

programme.title: Stromberg
programme.desc: Stromberg versucht Jennifer von seinen Vaterqualitäten zu überzeugen. Er ist bereit Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Stromberg beweist das, indem er bei Personalchef Nübel einen Fehler, den Ulf begangen hat, auf seine Kappe nimmt. Allerdings ahnt Stromberg nicht, was das für Konsequenzen hat. Parallel versucht Ernie, nach seiner Blamage beim Pfarrer, doch wieder in der Gemeinde Fuß zu fassen ... (P) Unterstützt durch Produktplatzierung

programme.title: Stromberg
programme.desc: Es sieht nicht gut aus für Stromberg. Es gibt eine Anhörung, in der so viel gegen ihn auf den Tisch kommt, dass er für die CAPITOL nicht mehr tragbar scheint. Aber so schnell gibt sich Stromberg nicht geschlagen. Ulf ist genervt vom Chef-Job, der ihm keinen Spaß macht. Er bekommt Probleme mit der Geschäftsleitung und Herr Nübel stellt auf der Suche nach einem geeigneten Übergangsleiter für die Schadensregulierung fest, dass Ernie der kompetenteste Mitarbeiter in der Abteilung ist ... (P) Unterstützt durch Produktplatzierung

programme.title: Stromberg - Der Film
programme.desc: Firmenfeiern sind wie das letzte Abendmahl. Immer zu wenig Weiber, das Essen ist schlecht und am Ende gibt´s Ärger´. Eine weise Vorahnung – und trotzdem macht sich Stromberg mit seinen Mitarbeitern aus der Schadensregulierung auf den Weg in ein Landhotel, in das die CAPITOL Versicherung die gesamte Belegschaft zur 50-Jahre-Jubiläumsfeier geladen hat. Es könnte so ein schöner Abend werden – hätte Stromberg nicht erfahren, dass die Schließung seiner Filiale unmittelbar bevor steht. Rettung verspricht nur ein Wechsel in die Zentrale – und genau den will er auf der Feier anbahnen, wo alle Entscheidungsträger der CAPITOL versammelt sind. Doch ausgerechnet Ernie hat denselben Plan – und liefert sich mit Stromberg ein Duell, in dem sich beide dem Vorstand von ihrer allerbesten Seite präsentieren. Und Stromberg wäre nicht Stromberg, wenn er nicht trotzdem auf seine unvergleichliche Art punkten könnte. So scheint das Ziel ganz nah – und doch so fern. Denn irgendetwas ist faul im Staate CAPITOL, und Stromberg muss sich entscheiden: Soll er sich durchmogeln wie sonst auch, oder soll er diesmal Farbe bekennen und alles auf eine Karte setzen?
