programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. programme.title: Wild Sardinia
programme.desc: Sardinia has always been the epitome of pure wilderness, an emerald of volcanic origin in the Mediterranean. 1900 metres of coastline and an infinite maze of offshore islands. But Sardinia also has other facets: green valleys, rugged mountains, murmuring brooks, mysterious ruins and a unique fauna. Just off of Sardinia's coast is an untouched underwater paradise - uniquely beautiful, but also dangerous. Pilot whales, dolphins and mobula rays populate the waters at Capo Testa in the north of the island. In the west, the lagoons of Cabras represent a wild landscape of lakes in which thousands of flamingos live and hunt the red brine shrimps. In addition to the flamingos, grey and purple herons and little egrets breed here. Thousands of bats have found refuge in the craggy mountain world of the Supramonte and Gennargentu, with their countless grottoes and caves. In the sea we can observe the mass mating of sea slugs, and thanks to our camera robots and submersible boats we were able to observe beard worms with luminous red gills, as well as bright yellow tree corals in the area surrounding the hypothermal lava holes.

Monte Isola, as the island is called after its central mountain lies close to its two neighboring islands, Isola di San Paolo and Isola di Loreto. As early as the 11th century, a monastic association of Benedictines settled here. For many Italians, Lake Iseo is the most beautiful spot in their homeland. It is all the more astonishing how little the influence of tourism is here. Driving is strictly forbidden on the three islands, and only on Monte Isola. Only on Monte Isola there is a regular bus service in the summertime. Thus, the three islands are an oasis of an oasis of tranquility most of the year. The historical buildings and the nature remind of the long tradition in which the Italians have cultivated this retreat. Only every five years in the autumn a big celebration takes place. Then over 200,000 paper flowers decorate the island. The flowers are reminiscent of the time in the Middle Ages when a Roma woman brought her son to the island to be cured from the from the rampant plague. In gratitude, she donated a sea of flowers. The Festa di Santa Croce has been one of the main attractions in northern Italy ever since. The days are radiant with color, it is the only time when it gets crowded in the small streets of the island villages. The next festival was celebrated in September 2021.

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida
programme.desc: Capri and Ischia are world famous. From Naples, it's just a short hop over to the two islands. Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.title: mareTV: Venice - Lagoon and Legend
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Andromeda
programme.desc: Nach 300 Jahren unfreiwilligen Kälteschlafes wird Captain Dylan Hunt, Commander des Raumschiffes Andromeda, mit einer ihm völlig fremden Welt konfrontiert: Die Vereinigung der Planeten, in deren Auftrag er unterwegs war, existiert nicht mehr. Statt dessen herrscht Krieg und Chaos. Captain Dylan Hunt und eine bunt zusammengewürfelte Raumschiffcrew setzen alles daran, wieder Ordnung zu schaffen und die galaxisweite Kooperation der Planeten zu erneuern - ein äußerst gefährliches Unternehmen!

Captain Dylan Hunt und eine bunt zusammengewürfelte Raumschiffcrew setzen alles daran, wieder Ordnung zu schaffen und die galaxisweite Kooperation der Planeten zu erneuern - ein äußerst gefährliches Unternehmen!

programme.title: Marketplace
programme.desc: Canada's consumer watchdog series since 1972, this news program uncovers wrongdoings in the marketplace. With the help of hidden cameras, correspondents dish out the dirt on not so "clean" business practices. Once they get the evidence they need on tape, they apply pressure on businesses to change policies vis-a-vis the products and services they provide to the public.

programme.title: About That
programme.desc: Andrew Chang expands the understanding of the stories everybody's talking about.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.desc: Dolph Lundgren interpreta a Jack Devlin, un U.S Marshal que protege a clientes de alto perfil cuando se trata de una cuestión de seguridad.

programme.title: El Proyecto Supermente
programme.desc: El proyecto Supermente es un programa secreto del gobierno en la guerra psicotrónica que sale mal. Ahora hay que eliminar a todos los involucrados. Huyendo por su vida, Jennifer Gaines debe descubrir quién ha robado la tecnología con planes de usarla para poner a Estados Unidos de rodillas. Cuando los desastres comienzan de verdad, el secreto más oscuro del experimento comienza a desvelarse.

programme.title: Colapso Global
programme.desc: El caos reina en nuestro planeta, llueve fuego del cielo y las personas deben matar para sobrevivir. Un grupo de habitantes de Pleasent, Washington, liderados por el alcalde, busca un refugio en un lugar elevado. Mientras la Tierra empieza a quebrarse, entre avalanchas, volcanes y motines, la caravana se enfrenta a un viaje por carretera en un paisaje postapocalíptico que nunca olvidarán.

programme.title: Independence Daysaster
programme.desc: Cuando la Tierra es atacada por una fuerza alienígena hostil, un bombero de un pueblo y un equipo científico de SETI se alían para activar la única tecnología capaz de derrotar a los invasores.

programme.title: La espada del asesino
programme.desc: Nguyen Vu es el único sobreviviente de su familia que fue ejecutada por la emperatriz de Vietnam. Descubre que tal atrocidad fue motivada tras ser acusados por delitos que no cometieron y se propone hacer justicia y limpiar su nombre.

programme.title: Santos y soldados
programme.desc: Cuatro soldados estadounidenses y un británico durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial luchan por regresar al territorio aliado después de ser separados de las fuerzas estadounidenses durante la histórica Masacre de Malmedy.

programme.title: Kung Fu Killer 1
programme.desc: Un monje caucásico de Shanghai se infiltra en los bajos fondos para encontrar a los asesinos de su Gran Maestro espiritual femenino.

programme.title: Tormenta nuclear
programme.desc: Las alarmas se disparan en una central nuclear, que para colmo, se ve afectada por una tormenta de gran intensidad. Los encargados deberán hacer frente a esta situación para evitar una catástrofe.

programme.title: Collider
programme.desc: En el año 2033, una joven atrapada en un misterioso orfanato viaja imprudentemente al pasado para encontrar a sus padres y enmendar su pasado.

programme.title: Rabia
programme.desc: Una mujer desarrolla el gusto por la sangre humana después de una cirugía plástica experimental, y sus víctimas se convierten en zombis sedientos de sangre, lo que lleva a una epidemia en toda la ciudad.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mientras un hombre conduce su moto por el desierto, unos matones le roban el vehículo y lo dan por muerto. Sobrevive y ya no piensa en el suicidio, porque ahora tiene un objetivo en la vida: vengarse y recuperar su moto.

programme.title: Behewulf: la Leyenda Vikinga
programme.desc: Dinamarca, siglo VI. El rey danés Hrothgar y sus guerreros matan a un trol cuyo hijo, Grendel, jura vengarse.

programme.title: Scarecrow
programme.desc: Seis estudiantes de secundaria se enfrentan a una entidad maligna mientras cumplen su castigo antes del festival del espantapájaros del pueblo.

programme.title: Asalto al Cine
programme.desc: Unos jóvenes en México planean un atraco a un cine, sin saber que sus vidas van a cambiar drásticamente tras el crimen.

programme.title: Brotherly Love

programme.title: Cherry Grove Stories

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: Stephen Hawking: Reise durchs All
programme.desc: Stephen Hawking setzt seine Mission als Raumschiff-Kommandant fort. Er trifft dabei auf eine außerirdische KI und landet auf einer alternativen Erde. Die Suche nach der Weltformel bringt ihn sogar bis an den Rand des Universums. Dabei stellt Hawking auch die Frage, was darüber hinaus existiert und ob wir es nicht vielmehr mit einem "Multiversum" zu tun haben.

programme.title: Besser essen, länger leben?
programme.desc: Aktuelle Forschungsergebnisse weisen darauf hin, dass unsere Ernährung der wichtigste Faktor für anhaltende Gesundheit und ein langes Leben ist. Ärzte, Köche und Ernährungswissenschaftler zeigen, wie wir gesünder leben können, indem wir frische Zutaten in unsere täglichen Mahlzeiten einbauen - ohne dass der Geschmack dabei zu kurz kommt.

programme.title: Der Feinkost-Tempel von Bologna
programme.desc: Das gesamte kulinarische Angebot Italiens, gebündelt unter einem Dach - nicht weniger verheißt die "Fico Eataly World", die in Bologna ihre Tore geöffnet hat. Sechs Millionen Besucher will der weltweit größte Feinkost-Tempel jährlich anziehen. Doch die ortsansässigen kleineren Lebensmittelerzeuger fühlen sich durch die Marktmacht der Konkurrenz in ihrer Existenz bedroht.

programme.desc: Token is a charismatic club owner who’s inherited his father’s iconic jazz club, and uses it at a sanctuary for the broken and struggling artists. When a shady music executive starts to recruit his talent, he fights to keep his club afloat.

programme.desc: A doctor is driving home from a conference when he learns his daughter has been kidnapped, and the betrayal comes from those closest to him. With each mile, the certainty that someone within his trusted circle is responsible turns the journey into a spiral of shock and resolve, as the threat to his daughter’s life grows more personal and more urgent.

programme.desc: When a blind date ends in a shootout, Krystal Gray is left with more questions than answers. She discovers a flash drive linked to the murder and a web of secrets involving her brother, a dirty cop, and a mysterious man named Jarrell. As she uncovers the truth, Krystal becomes the target in a deadly game where love and betrayal blur and everyone has a hidden agenda.

programme.desc: Azariyah, a rising content creator and self-proclaimed relationship expert has routine live event online discussing relationships and creating content. When Danica reaches out to her about her boyfriend’s sexuality, Azariyah suggests she confronts him, which leads to Danica taking her own life. Haunted by the guilt, Azariyah searches for the truth amidst a wave of threats and online violence.

programme.title: Your Man Will be Mine
programme.desc: Fed up with her neglectful boyfriend Cory, Raina seizes a golden opportunity when he’s arrested by stealing his bail money and vanishes. Seeking refuge with her cousin Jessica, Raina’s survival instinct takes a dark turn as she is tempted by Jessica’s boyfriend, hoping to secure a new life. But when Cory unexpectedly busts out of jail and comes hunting for his cash, Raina must choose love or survival.

programme.title: ToxiCity

Despite his app's mission, he struggles with love, further complicated by a child support order. A night out leads him to Sierra, an alluring actress who quickly moves in. Their romance sours as Sierra's past as a dancer and her aggressive jealousy come to light.

programme.title: We in This Together

To hide her infertility, Daisha secretly adopts 17-year-old "Lil August," sparking an immediate, violent rivalry. While August dismisses the teen’s lethal behavior as "playful," Daisha finds herself trapped in a house with a son who may be a killer. As she plots to conceive a biological heir, a series of dark secrets and "accidents" leave the family’s survival in question.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Die Internationale Meisterschaft für Hersteller (IMC) war eine Rallye-Serie, die von 1970 bis 72 ausgetragen wurde. Automobilhersteller wie Porsche, Renault, Fiat und Ford beteiligten sich Daran. 1972 war Ford besonders erfolgreich.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Die Deutsche Rallye-Meisterschaft ist eine populäre Motorsportserie, die seit 1970 ausgetragen wird. 1983 waren die sportlichen Modelle von Opel besonders erfolgreich.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Mit dem Quattro brachte AUDI 1985 eine vollkommen neue Antriebsart in den Motorsport. Im Rallyebereich kreierten die Ingolstädter damit eine völlig neue Dimension. Ein Filmbeitrag der besonderen Art.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Afrika und die Rallye-Welt. Staub, Hitze, Schlamm, fast unmenschliche Strapazen für Fahrer und Maschinen. Das zeigt eine spannende Dokumentation über die Rallye-Weltmeisterschaft 1982.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Ob Ponton-Mercedes, Heckflosse oder Luxus-Coupe, viele Jahre fährt Mercedes im Rallyesport vorneweg. Und egal wo die Autos mit dem Stern starten gewinnen sie, ob in Monte Carlo, Argentinien oder Afrika. Aber die großen Karossen gewinnen nicht weil sie besonders sportlich sind, sondern sie siegen durch Kraft und eine bis dahin nicht gekannte Zuverlässigkeit.

programme.title: Audi Quattro - Der Rallye-Klassiker
programme.desc: Vorsprung durch Technik auf der Rallyepiste. Der Audi Quattro schockiert seine Gegner.

programme.title: Ein Traum wird wahr: Ausfahrt im 1 Mio € teuren Mercedes 300 SL | SL-Historie
programme.desc: Zum 70-jährigen Jubiläum blicken wir zurück auf die bewegte Geschichte des Mercedes SL. Angefangen mit dem W194 im Jahr 1952 – über die Generationen W198, W113, R107, R129, R230 und R231 – bis heute. Was macht die beiden Buchstaben zur Legende und wie ist es einmal hinter dem Steuer eines Millionen-Euro-teuren Mercedes 300 SL Roadster zu sitzen?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Der Opel Combo ist seit seiner Einführung bei Handwerkern wie Familien sehr beliebt. Wir haben einen Blick auf die aktualisierte Version geworfen. Außerdem: Volvo hat mit dem XC40 ein neues Mobilitätskonzept namens Care by Volvo vorgestellt.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Kia bietet gute Autos zu fairen Preisen. Wir haben den Kia Stinger im Alltag in der Münchner Innenstadt getestet. Außerdem: Seats Sportmarke Cupra stellt mit dem Ateca ein günstiges Performance-SUV vor. Und: ein Crossover für die Stadt, der Fiat 500X.

programme.title: Perfect Ride

programme.title: Perfect Ride

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Das Auto wechseln wie Unterwäsche. Mit Book by Cadillac können Kunden unbegrenzt oft ihr Fahrzeug wechseln, ohne zusätzliche Kosten. Außerdem: Volvo stellt mit dem Polestar 1 sein erstes Elektroauto vor. Weitere Plug-in-Hybride sollen bis 2020 folgen.

programme.title: Der neue Subaru Forester: Härtetest im Gelände!
programme.desc: Robust, zuverlässig, allradgetrieben: Seit fast 30 Jahren ist der Subaru Forester ein treuer Begleiter für Abenteuersuchende. Wir testen die neue sechste Auflage ausgiebig on- und offroad und verraten spannende Facts zum japanischen 4x4-Spezialisten.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Die Stunt Heroes sind auf Tour! Auf einem Industriegelände in Thüringen finden sie den idealen Platz um mit dem Stuntwagen quer durch einen fahrenden LKW-Anhänger zu springen. Problem: der Trailer ist nagelneu und darf auf keinen Fall kaputt gehen. Eine besondere Herausforderung für Stuntkoordinator Domi und sein Team!

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Die Stunt Heroes sind immer auf der Suche nach Action. In dieser Folge simulieren sie eine Verfolgung zwischen einem Kipplaster und einem Auto. An deren Ende rast das Auto in einen Kieshaufen. Weil er heute Geburtstag hat, darf Stuntman Stefan das Crashauto fahren!

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: In dieser Folge der Stunt Heroes dreht sich alles um das Thema Feuer. Die Jungs der Firma action concept wollen Flächenbrand entzünden. Inmitten der Flammen soll möglichst lange ein Stuntman stehen. Bis der Stunt steht, müssen die Helden des Actionfilms noch einige Tests durchzuführen!

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Die Stunt Heroes drehen bei action concept einen epischen Bodyfight zwischen Ordnungshütern und Gesetzlosen auf der Flucht-und zwar das volle Programm: Heftige Prügel im Nahkampf, Glasflaschen bersten auf Köpfen, Körper fliegen durch Wände. Zum Schluss fliegt das Gangsterauto über 15 Meter hoch, detoniert in der Luft und hinterlässt eine Spur der Verwüstung.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: In der Stuntschmiede action concept werden jedes Jahr über 100 Autos für Filmstunts geschrottet. In einer neuen Folge der Serie Stunt Heroes wird ein Quadfahrer von einem Auto verfolgt. Dabei geht das Auto natürlich zu Bruch. Auch das Quad muss dran glauben - die Frage ist nur: wie? Denn mit diesem Stunt betreten die Stunt Heroes Neuland. Keiner weiß, ob es klappt.

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: Das Stunt Heroes sind zum wiederholten Male zu Gast bei der Firma Fliegl Fahrzeugbau in Thüringen. Ihr Ziel ist es, auf dem weitläufigen Industriegelände ein komplettes Stuntvideo zu drehen. programme.title: Agatha Christie: Kleine Morde

Als er verkündet, eine 25-Jährige geheiratet zu haben, bangt die Familie um ihr Erbe. Und tatsächlich stirbt der Capitaine bei einem Feuer...

programme.title: Das Duell in der verbotenen Stadt

Um den gefürchteten Outlaw und Bandenchef Saimoon, auch bekannt als "Gott des Schwertes", dingfest zu machen, entsendet der junge Kaiser seinen besten Mann: Dragon 9. Der jedoch kann den Gesuchten auch erst einmal bloß dazu überreden, sich einem Duell zu stellen. Dieser Kampf, an dem auch Yip Ku-sing, "der fliegende Himmelskämpfer", teilnehmen soll, wird dem Wunsch des Kaisers gemäß mitten in Peking stattfinden - direkt über den Dächern der verbotenen Stadt, beobachtet nur von acht ausgesuchten Zeugen, deren Auswahl Dragon 9 obliegt. Mit ihr erleben die Baker Boys einen künstlerischen Aufschwung, doch die neue Dynamik bringt auch Spannungen mit sich. Während Frank auf Stabilität und Geschäftssinn setzt, beginnt Jack, sich emotional und künstlerisch von seinem Bruder zu entfernen – nicht zuletzt wegen seiner wachsenden Gefühle für Susie. Die fragile Balance zwischen beruflichem Erfolg, familiärer Bindung und persönlichen Sehnsüchten droht zu zerbrechen.

programme.desc: Ein Polizist im Ruhestand und sein Bruder, ein Kleinkrimineller, kaufen ein Rennpferd, finden aber ihre Pläne für leichtes Geld verkompliziert, wenn ein Gangster das Pferd stiehlt. Mit Kiefer Sutherland, Anthony LaPaglia.

programme.title: Schnelle Entscheidung
programme.desc: Inspiriert von einer wahren Geschichte spielt Mare Winningham eine junge verwitwete Mutter; die wegen Kinderpornografie und Missbrauchs vor Gericht steht; nachdem sie zulässt; dass ihre Freundin (Felicity Huffman) ihre Töchter und Freunde fotografiert.

programme.title: The Limey
programme.desc: Ein äußerst unberechenbarer und gefährlicher Engländer reist nach Los Angeles, um den Mann zu finden, den er für den Tod seiner Tochter verantwortlich macht.

programme.title: Briefe an Julia
programme.desc: Im modernen Verona, wo Frauen auf der Suche nach ihren Romeos Briefe an Julia hinterlassen, findet eine junge Schriftstellerin (Amanda Seyfried) einen 50 Jahre alten Brief, der ihr Leben verändert.

programme.title: Six Minutes to Midnight
programme.desc: Ein Literatur- und Sprachlehrer an einem Mädcheninternat wird in eine Nazi-Verschwörung verwickelt.

programme.title: Judy
programme.desc: Die Showbiz-Legende Judy Garland kommt für ihre letzten Konzerte nach London. Nachdem sie 45 ihrer 47 Jahre gearbeitet hat, wird sie von Erinnerungen an eine Kindheit in Hollywood heimgesucht und sehnt sich nach der Rückkehr zu ihren Kindern.

programme.title: Voll auf Droge
programme.desc: Jerry nähert sich dem Ende eines Drogenrehabilitationsprogramms und kündigt seinen Job in einem Fast-Food-Restaurant aus einem Impuls heraus, als eine attraktive Frau am Drive-Fenster erscheint. Die beiden gehen in ein Motel, wo er ihr von seinem Leben erzählt.

programme.title: Blindspotting

programme.desc: After inheriting her family's moving company, a young woman starts to clash with the manager who thought he was going to take over.

programme.title: Game of Love
programme.desc: Ex-Wife Frances conspires with her grown children to force Jake to sell his cherished Seattle basketball team. Will game changing moves off the court help reignite romantic sparks?

programme.title: Target My Daughter
programme.desc: A mother and daughter in a witness protection program are hunted by a ruthless gun for hire.

programme.title: A Christmas Wedding Date
programme.desc: After Rebecca is fired, she goes back home to see her mother for the holidays where she also attend a wedding on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: The Nurse
programme.desc: A young woman takes in her estranged father after he suffers a stroke, but his home-care nurse's attentive dedication may be masking a dark and dangerous secret.

programme.title: 40 Below & Falling
programme.desc: A rom-com about the adventures of a small town teacher, Kate Carter, going back to the city for her wedding. After a blizzard strikes, she is forced to travel with a stranger named Redford who leaves her questioning her future plans.

programme.title: Another Man's Wife
programme.desc: After a tragic car accident, a family gets away to a remote mountain cabin to recover and rebuild their lives. During their vacation, a handsome man befriends them only to get revenge and destroy what is left of their fragile lives.

programme.title: Amber Alert
programme.desc: A woman goes on the run with her children to escape an abusive husband, who is the District Attorney. He puts out an Amber Alert for them.

programme.title: A Moving Romance
programme.desc: After inheriting her family's moving company, a young woman starts to clash with the manager who thought he was going to take over.

programme.title: Badge of Betrayal
programme.desc: Zoey, a cyber crime specialist doesn't seem to connect with her detective husband Dave anymore, but they try to make it work for their 6-year-old son Timmy. While in the middle of a complicated stalker case, Zoey realizes that those long nights at work were actually an excuse for Dave to be messing around, and Zoey ends up kicking Dave out. She gets sole custody of Timmy until the divorce. At the same time, her cyberstalker case moves further but she has to get involved more personnally to try and catch the culprit.

programme.title: A Christmas Wish
programme.desc: When Paula chose Gary over Nick, to take her to the senior prom, little did she know that 15 years later she’d be married, have two daughters and tons of debt. When Nick reappears, now a rich, successful art broker, Paula wishes her decision were different. With bills and troubles mounting, especially frustrating during the Christmas season, Paula wishes hard to trade places with Nick’s wife. A little Christmas magic and she is transported to the life with Nick. But, be careful what you wish for… Although she is financially rich, she is far from happy. Eventually her “dream” becomes a “nightmare,” as Nick wants a divorce and she can’t find a way back to Gary and her daughters. Will there be a Merry Christmas?

programme.title: Against the Wild: The Great Elephant Adventure
programme.desc: A lost orphan boy and a giant elephant team up to take down an elephant poaching syndicate.

programme.title: Deadly Daycare
programme.desc: After a few years of financial hardship, a young mother (RACHEL) decides to go back to work to help her ex-husband with the mounting bills. With no one to watch their 4-year-old daughter (MIA), the mother decides to enroll her into the local daycare center called Little Ones owned by a seemingly responsible older woman, (DEBORAH). After a few weeks of Mia's awkward behavior, Rachel concludes her daughter may be getting mistreated by (GABBY) one of the centers daycare teachers.

programme.title: Midnight Stallion
programme.desc: JACK and his daughter TERESA train a wild horse in hopes of winning enough money to save their farm.

programme.title: Meet You in Scotland
programme.desc: A Scottish poet mistakes a writer’s identity, forcing her to choose between new love or the truth.

programme.title: Eat, Love, London
programme.desc: Stella takes a job at a new London restaurant and ends up falling for the chef.

programme.title: Finding Love in Saint Lucia
programme.desc: An Ornithologist and a Journalist partner up to save an endangered bird species in the jungle of Saint Lucia.

programme.desc: A dancer and a boxer must team up for a big performance after a last minute drop out.

programme.desc: Manji vê sua irmã mais nova ser assassinada na sua frente e começa sua vingança. Uma mulher misteriosa aparecerá diante de Manji, concedendo-lhe juventude eterna e imortalidade. Em seguida, os pais de Rin Asano são mortos por um grupo de espadachins chamado Itto ruy, e o estúdio de esgrima de seus pais é destruído. Para se vingar, ela pedirá ajuda a Manji, e os dois lutarão contra os Itto ruy.

programme.title: Espantalho
programme.desc: Um grupo de amigos, perdido perto de um milharal deserto, encontra abrigo em uma antiga casa de fazenda, mas logo descobre que a moradia é o centro de um ritual sobrenatural.

programme.title: Departamento Q: O Efeito Marco
programme.desc: O detetive Carl Mørck e seu assistente Assad investigam a história de um menino de 12 anos chamado Marco que foi detido na fronteira dinamarquesa e que é a chave para descobrir uma rede de corrupção internacional. A franquia de filmes "Departamento Q" é baseada no best-seller de Jussi Adler Olsen.

programme.title: Profissão de Risco
programme.desc: Jack é contratado por Dragna, um chefão do crime, para realizar uma tarefa aparentemente inocente: ele deve levar uma mala para um motel em Nova Orleans e esperar que ela seja recolhida. Mas Jack nunca conseguirá abrir a mala. Mas, no momento em que ele entra no motel, sua vida está em risco. Vários criminosos tentam tirar a bolsa dele e Jack precisa defendê-la se quiser viver.

programme.title: Roubo a Máfia
programme.desc: Um casal especializado em roubar da máfia começa um trabalho tão grande que os torna alvos tanto da máfia quanto do FBI.

programme.title: Shock Wave 2
programme.desc: Poon Shing-Fung (Andy Lau) é um policial especialista em desarmar bombas. No meio de uma ação, uma explosão ocorre e ele acaba entrando em coma, além de perder a memória. Ao acordar, Poon recebe a informação de está sendo investigado, acusado de fazer parte do atentado que na verdade, ele estava trabalhando para tentar impedir. Enquanto isso, um verdadeiro terrorista especialista em explosivos, cuja gangue foi derrubada, busca vingança. Ele ameaça explodir um túnel de Hong Kong com centenas de reféns. O policial deverá tentar detê-lo novamente.

programme.title: O Justiceiro
programme.desc: Mestre em artes marciais e lutador, Kung Wei, vive numa casa humilde, com a esposa que está muito doente e com Johnny, seu filho que o adora e segue seus ensinamentos morais e de artes marciais. Kung Wei, é "recrutado" sigilosamente pela polícia, para disfarçado, desmantelar uma quadrilha em Hong Kong. Enquanto trabalhava com outra identidade, seu filho sofria com seus colegas que chamavam o pai de "bandido"; pois, a ele imputavam um crime. Neste meio tempo, sua esposa morre. Antes de morrer, ela confia a guarda do pequeno Johnny, ao policial que "investigava" Kung, supondo que se marido fosse um bandido perigoso. O mestre Kung Wei, terá que lutar muito nessa missão!

programme.title: Código da Máfia
programme.desc: Mike acaba de sair da prisão e aceita fazer um último serviço com seu irmão para poder se livrar do mundo do crime e cuidar de sua filha. Ele logo descobrirá que a justiça das ruas é muito pior que tudo o que passou na prisão.

programme.title: Origins of the Universe: The Great Debate
programme.desc: El mundo que nos rodea contiene muchos sistemas complejos que funcionan perfectamente juntos. Conozca a siete expertos en sus campos que han dedicado su vida al estudio de esta cuestión.

programme.title: Fuerza Polar

programme.desc: Se detecta actividad volcánica en el núcleo de la Tierra y los científicos descubren que la ciudad de Los Ángeles está a punto de ser borrada del mapa. Mientras el área es evacuada, un hombre vuelve a la ciudad para encontrar a su novia, pero descubre que ha sido secuestrada.

programme.title: El Bronx
programme.desc: Andrés encuentra en la música el valor para revelarse ante la voz de Manolo. Carlos tendrá la última oportunidad para salvar a su hija de las perversidades de Manolo.

programme.desc: Contra Manolo trabajan varios de sus enemigos que quieren acabar con su reino. Juliana será un apoyo indispensable para que Karen supere varios de sus traumas.

programme.title: El Bronx
programme.desc: Tovar estudia su estrategia como infiltrado, donde no hay espacio para los errores. Manolo tendrá que asumir la responsabilidad que representa el precio de la fama.

programme.title: El Bronx

programme.title: El Bronx

programme.title: El Bronx
programme.desc: Carlos cargará en su conciencia el peso de la muerte de Nina. Andrés aprovecha su talento para beneficiar a su madre y a Juliana. El dinero será lo que garantice libertad de Juliana.

A partir de entonces, comienzan a ocurrir sucesos extraños en el observatorio, lo que lo lleva a una búsqueda desesperada por descubrir la verdadera naturaleza de su hallazgo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Rinaker wants Nick and Sh’lainn eliminated because he’s afraid they know too much about the Alliance. The renegade bounty hunter and Banshee track an Alliance airship to its secret Roswell base. Logan is ready to turn himself in to get some answers, but the Banshee grab Sh’lainn and Logan must turn to the Alliance for help with her rescue.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: In his relentless search to find out what truly happened to his biological father, Logan uncovers something he didn’t bargain for – an assassin android that marches right up to the Alliance’s front door looking for its preprogrammed target – Nick Logan!

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Ruck, the werewolves pack leader, escapes from the Alliance and tracks down the EMP bomb which the Yeti race has been hiding. The doomsday device is accidentally activated while it’s being stolen, and Logan must discover its location before time runs out.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Cattle mutilation draws Logan to a small town and saddles him with a new partner, Dr. Petrovic. They discover science has spawned more trouble – hybrid, mutant, alien fire ants. Now they must rescue the townsfolk and the Detail Team before Rinaker calls an air strike on the town.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: A vampire that once worked for INTRAcom has mutated and is now staging attacks on his former boss’s holdings in an effort to protect the Brazilian rain forest. The creature rescues Logan, but Rinaker calls for an air strike on a lost Vampire city rather than risk its discovery by INTRAcom.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Logan and Fitz are missing and presumed dead while on a mission to locate a downed alien ship in Haiti. They have been captured by a race of slug-like beings that can only inhabit the bodies of dead humans, which transforms them into zombies. Logan and Fitz are next and time is running out.

programme.title: Dork Hunters and The Pirates of Tortuga Island
programme.desc: The Dork Hunters visit tropical Tortuga Island on their summer vacation, unaware that the Dork Commander and his second-in-command are at the same resort in search of a buried treasure chest full of micro-galaxies

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Water quality is everything—and the Star brite - SeaSafe team is back at it for the second year in a row! Led by Cory Redwine, Conservation Director of Project SeaSafe, this is the 4th Annual Clean Water Collective and it’s bigger than ever. This time, we’re in Grant, Florida, where 4 million clams are being released into the Indian River Lagoon, paired with the planting of thousands of mangroves, oyster work by CCA and trash clean ups to help restore one of Florida’s most critical ecosystems. But it’s not just about hard work—it’s about connection. With local captains, fishing legends, and the Local Knowledge crew on hand, we hit the water to show why this place is worth fighting for. From clam drops by drone, to in-water mangrove planting, to monster snook catches, this is hands-on conservation at its best. This two-part series kicks off with action, heart, and the kind of hope only a healthy waterway can bring. Don’t miss Part 1—where conservation meets community and everyone gets their hands wet.
